stories.title: Correct the rule texts that misdirect

notes.implementation: Implemented 2026-11-16 on 01983c1 (replayed as tree 6fd1679). Help and title of undocumented_unsafe_blocks, help of orphan_module_file and blocking_call_in_async in src/policy/catalog; unreferenced_feature message in src/structure/manifest.rs; permissive_lint_table states the distinct sites src/execution/manifest_allows.rs drops, joined in src/execution.rs after Clippy (no count when Clippy did not lint every member the entry covers, e.g. under --package); inherited dependency keys anchor on the member line in src/cargo_health/keys.rs. Proof from the binary: tests/rule_texts.rs (6 tests). Windows: Clippy clean on 1.99.1, doc gates green, Windows gate green in a CRLF worktree (34 failures, all in the ledger). Linux gates go to US-037.
notes.release_note: Messages that change finding ids, for .github/releases/v0.12.0.md (US-032): unreferenced_feature 'which no cfg reads' becomes 'which no cfg and no build script reads'; permissive_lint_table appends ', which hides N findings in this package.' (or 'in the packages that inherit it', 'no finding', '1 finding'). Help and title changes do not change ids. Inherited dependency findings gain a span: ids unchanged, --scope lines now keeps them only when their key line changes, and a baseline without the span still pairs through the fallback key.
